versions.content: If a Category 2 ISR calls DisableAllInterupts() / SuspendAllInterrupts() / SuspendOSInterrupts() and ends (returns) without calling the corresponding EnableAllInterrupts() / ResumeAllInterrupts() / ResumeOSInterrupts(), the Operating System module shall perform the missing service and shall call the ErrorHook() (if configured) with the status E_OS_DISABLEDINT.
